stem: Which event occurred as a result of General Cornwallis's surrender at the Battle of Yorktown?

options.label: A
options.text: France recognized American independence and declared war against Great Britain.

options.label: B
options.text: The Second Continental Congress agreed to the Articles of Confederation.

options.label: C
options.text: Great Britain and the United States signed the Treaty of Paris.

options.label: D
options.text: The Second Continental Congress sent the Olive Branch Petition to King George III.
